config.label: Open States API key from open
config.description: Open States API key from open.pluralpolicy.com. Required to make any API requests.

config.label: Maximum upstream Open States requests per rolling 24 hours
config.description: Maximum upstream Open States requests per rolling 24 hours. Rejects before the request is issued once spent. Defaults to the v3 free-tier daily cap.

config.label: Per-attempt upstream request deadline in milliseconds (minimum 1000)
config.description: Per-attempt upstream request deadline in milliseconds (minimum 1000). Expiry is non-retryable. Open States answers a scoped query in under a second to ~57s and its gateway gives up near 60s.

config.label: Wall-clock ceiling in milliseconds for one call across every retry attempt and the backoff between them
config.description: Wall-clock ceiling in milliseconds for one call across every retry attempt and the backoff between them. Bounds a slow upstream that keeps failing retryably. Must be at least OPENSTATES_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS; startup rejects a lower value.

config.label: Sets the minimum log level for output (e
config.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
